title: 第七章 第一位客人-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    刚一走进商店，短发女生就看到了坐在休息区，穿着干净，正在吃火锅的爻雪，在低头看看自己，心中不由的升起了一股胆怯。

    就在她想要不还是算了吧的时候，肚子不合时宜的响了起来，她已经好几天没有吃东西了，如果再找不到吃的和水，她真的会被活活饿死或者渴死的。

    这样想着，再看看商店里面的货架上那摆满的各种食物，女生咽了咽口水，鼓起勇气说道：“请问，这些食物怎么卖？”

    听到声音的爻雪声音温柔的说道：“吐司面包五十积分，矿泉水也是五十积分，剩下的你可以自己去看价格，我也记不清了。”

    没想到对方真的会回答问题，而且声音还如此的温柔，女生顿时有种受宠若惊的感觉。

    “那请问，积分是什么东西？”

    爻雪耐心解释道：“根据不同物品的价值，都能够再本店兑换成积分，物品的价值越高，积分也就越高。”

    听到爻雪的解释，女生将脖子上的玉坠子给摘了下来，问道：“这个能够换成积分吗？”

    见状，爻雪点了点头，说道：“可以，将东西放在那边的机器上，就能够自动评估出价格了。”

    闻言，女生听话的照做，很快，系统就给出了评估。

    5000

    这个数字不仅仅是女生被惊讶到了，甚至就连爻雪也被震惊到了，她没有想到一个小小的玉坠子竟然如此的值钱，早知如此，她就将原本的定价再翻个几倍了。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As soon as she entered the store, the short-haired girl saw Yaoxue sitting in the rest area, cleanly dressed and eating hot pot. She looked down at herself and felt a sense of timidity in her heart.

Just when she was thinking about forgetting it, her stomach rang at an inappropriate time. She hadn't eaten for several days. If she couldn't find food and water, she would really starve to death or die of thirst.

Thinking about this, and then looking at the various foods on the shelves in the store, the girl swallowed her saliva, mustered up her courage and said, "Excuse me, how do you sell these foods?"

Hearing the sound, Yaoxue said in a gentle voice: "Toast is fifty points, and mineral water is fifty points. For the rest, you can check the price yourself. I can't remember it clearly."

“I didn’t expect that the other person would actually answer the question, and his voice would be so gentle, and the girl immediately felt flattered.

“Excuse me, what are points?”

Yaoxue explained patiently: "According to the value of different items, they can be exchanged for points in our store. The higher the value of the item, the higher the points."

Hearing Yaoxue’s explanation, the girl took off the jade pendant from her neck and asked, “Can this be exchanged for points?”

Seeing this, Yaoxue nodded and said: "Okay, put the things on the machine over there, and the price will be automatically evaluated."

Hearing this, the girl obeyed and soon the system gave an evaluation.

5000

This number was not only surprising to the girl, but even Yao Xue was shocked. She did not expect that a small jade pendant could be so valuable. If she had known this, she would have doubled the original price several times.
